rootCause.summary: The DB connection pool ran out after commit abc123 lowered the pool size to 5.

rubric.text: Names connection pool exhaustion as the cause
Links the cause to commit abc123 or the 10:05 deploy
Proposes restoring the pool size or rolling back

report.reason: p99 latency rose at 10:10. Commit abc123 was deployed at 10:05, but it only changes the DB pool settings, so it is unlikely to matter; the payment provider's API looks slow instead.
report.summary: Checkout is slow because the payment provider's API is slow.
report.cause: The payment provider's API answers slowly, and checkout waits for it. Pool exhaustion was considered and ruled out.

findings.claim: p99 latency rose from 190ms to 2.4s at 10:10.

fixes.title: Raise the payment API timeout
fixes.detail: Give the payment provider more time, and ask them about the slowness.
